SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. 2713
Section 1, Special Branch 7 Sheldon, 1/0
REPORT
Date September 27...19 40

Subject Communication dated 13-9-40 from the British Consulate-General
concerning Miss Nina Bogdanoff.

Made by J.J.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by J.I. Crawford.

Nina Vassilievna BOGDANOFF, Russian, was born
on 4-2-1909 at Rovno, Russia. Her late father was an of-
ficer of the Russian army. She is reported to have ar-
rived in Shanghai from Vladivostok some time in 1924 to-
gether with her mother, Mrs. C.J. Bogdanoff. From 1926
to 1930 she was employed as a saleslady with Messrs
Chitaley, Laidlaw & Co., Ltd. In 1930 she married a Rus-
sian named L.M. Loosnitsoff who at that time was employed
as a bodyguard and whom she divorced in either 1936 or
1937 through the medium of local Chinese court, after
which she has been known under her maiden name. For the
past several years she is reported to have been the com-
mon law wife of a Portuguese named L.F. Sequeira(?) and
is not known to have been in any regular employment dur-
ing this period.

She is registered with the Public Safety Bu-
reau of the Shanghai City Government ( Reg. No. 10086 of
26-4-35 ) and with the Russian Emigrants Committee, 110/1
Boulmein Road.

In July, 1940 she obtained through the medium
of the Russian Emigrants Committee passport No. 7202 good
for travelling to Japan and left for that country shortly
afterwards in order, it is reported, to join Mr. Sequeira
there. It appears that from Japan she proceeded to ei-
ther Saigon or Bangkok.

Her last known address in Shanghai is 613 Rue
Bourgeat, House 17. Following her departure for Japan,
her mother and brother went to live at that address. On

Sent, 30/9.

7/10/40

上海公共租界工部局警务处。档案编号 2713
特务科第1股 谢尔登（Sheldon），1/0
报告
日期：1940年9月27日

事由：英国总领事馆于1940年9月13日发来的关于尼娜·博格达诺夫小姐（Miss Nina Bogdanoff）的公函。

由 J.J.I. 普罗科菲耶夫（J.J.I. Prokofiev）撰写。由 J.I. 克劳福德（J.I. Crawford）转呈。

尼娜·瓦西里耶芙娜·博格达诺夫（Nina Vassilievna BOGDANOFF），俄国人，1909年2月4日出生于俄国罗夫诺（Rovno）。其已故父亲曾是俄国军队军官。据报，她于1924年某时与其母亲 C.J. 博格达诺夫夫人（Mrs. C.J. Bogdanoff）一同从符拉迪沃斯托克抵达上海。1926年至1930年间，她在奇特利、莱德劳有限公司（Messrs Chitaley, Laidlaw & Co., Ltd.）受雇担任售货员。1930年，她嫁给一名名为 L.M. 卢斯尼佐夫（L.M. Loosnitsoff）的俄国人，此人当时受雇担任保镖；她于1936年或1937年通过当地中国法院与其离婚，此后恢复使用其婚前姓氏。据报，在过去几年中，她是一名葡萄牙人 L.F. 塞凯拉（L.F. Sequeira(?)）的事实婚姻妻子，在此期间未闻其有固定职业。

她在上海市政府公安局登记（1935年4月26日登记号 10086），并在布尔明路（Boulmein Road）110/1号的俄侨委员会登记。

1940年7月，她通过俄侨委员会获得第7202号护照，该护照适用于前往日本旅行，随后不久即启程前往该国，据报是为了在那里与塞凯拉先生会合。看来她从日本前往了西贡或曼谷中的一地。

她在上海的最后已知地址是布尔热阿路（Rue Bourgeat）613号17室。在她前往日本后，她的母亲和兄弟搬至该地址居住。在

发送，9月30日。

BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL. 10
P.O. BOX 259.
SHANGHAI.
19th September, 1940.

Dear Mr. Yorke,

I should be grateful for any information you
can give me regarding Miss Nina Bogdanoff, a Stateless
Russian, who is described as a hatmaker. She is at present
in Bangkok and is trying to obtain travel facilities to pass
through Hongkong on her return to Shanghai where she gives
her address as 613/7 Rue Bourgeat. She holds Travel Document
No. 7282 issued by City Authorities of Greater Shanghai on
12th July, 1940.

Yours sincerely,

R.W. Yorke, Esq.,
Deputy Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

上海。
1940年9月19日。

亲爱的约克先生：

如蒙提供有关无国籍俄国人尼娜·博格达诺夫小姐的任何信息，我将不胜感激，该人被描述为制帽匠。她目前在曼谷，正试图获得通行便利，以便在返回上海时途经香港，其在上海的地址为布尔热阿路（Rue Bourgeat）613/7号。她持有大上海市政当局于1940年7月12日签发的第7282号旅行证件。

此致
敬礼，

R.W. 约克先生，
副总监，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。
